retheme.note: The Slab is a DARK map, and this is how it is made one without editing the Eater checkout: the modules its own dev server serves are rewritten in flight, on their way to the browser. Set flavor back to "light", drop to [] and markerOpacity to null and NOTHING is rewritten — no module is even intercepted — which is the capture that shipped before #188. Every rewrite says how many times it must match, and a count that does not agree stops the run: a light Slab on disk looks exactly like a right one until somebody opens it. design/eater-slab/README.md says why this lives here rather than in the Eater checkout.
